metadata.name: The Binding of Noita
metadata.description:
[h1]Welcome to this mod! If you are interested in the mod, find bugs or have other suggestions, please feel free to give feedback.[/h1]
[h1]Prerequisites and Gameplay Settings[/h1] [list]
[*]Non-mandatory prerequisite mod: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3127536138]Confession Dragon[/url] (Without installing this prerequisite mod, you cannot switch wands via the scroll wheel and can only use the spacebar to switch)
[*]Mandatory setting: Due to rendering conflicts, please close the left-side attribute panel during gameplay to avoid visual interference (this will be optimized to an automatic setting in the future)
[*]Control: Please enable mouse control during gameplay; controller support is not yet available. Press [b] B [/b] To Open The Bag and use the [b] mouse wheel [/b] to switch spells.[b] Left-click [/b] to fire.
[/list]
[h1]Core Gameplay Introduction[/h1]
[list]
[*]New playable character - Mina. When starting the game with this character, the basic gameplay is consistent with the original Noita
[*]In the current version, wands support global editing (this setting may be adjusted in the future)
[*][b]Important Note: Due to the generation mechanism of spells/wands being the replacement of non-quest tagged items, you will not encounter any non-quest items when playing as Mina[/b]
[/list]
[h1]Future Update Plan[/h1]
[list]
[*]We will continue to improve the mod content in the future. The update goals include:
[*]Complete spells that can be implemented under the Isaac mechanism
[*][spoiler]Improve related API functions, add Sun Side Quest, Magic Orb, Three Eyes and other contents[/spoiler]
[/list]
[h1]Feedback Instructions[/h1]
If you encounter any bugs during gameplay, please feel free to feedback in the "BUGs" section. Thank you for your support and help!
